paper_title: Thinking Slow, Fast Scaling Inference Compute with Distilled Reasoners
caption: : Majority voting.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions (k) and the accuracy voting, measured as a percentage. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)," is a linear scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁷, with tick labels spaced by powers of 2, starting at 2⁰ and incrementing to 2⁷. The y-axis, labeled "Majority voting accuracy (%)," is a linear scale ranging from 0.3 to 0.6, with tick labels spaced by approximately 0.02. A solid purple line represents the accuracy voting, beginning near 0.3 at k=2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.48 at k=2⁷. A solid light blue line represents the accuracy voting, beginning around 0.38 at k=2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.44 at k=2⁷. A solid green line represents the accuracy voting, beginning around 0.4 at k=2⁰ and increasing to approximately 0.55 at k=2⁷.
